title.ja: 係数ジャンプ拡散：共有流束とMG・AMG
title.en: Checkerboard diffusion: shared flux, MG and AMG

summary.ja: 不連続係数のFV解を独立なP1参照と比較し、線形系の残差・前進誤差と連続問題の誤差を分けます。
summary.en: Compare discontinuous-coefficient FV with independent P1 reference fields, separating linear-system residual/forward errors from continuum error.

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形、零Dirichlet、f=1、対角2象限100/残り1、N16/32/64。参照P1は128/192。
assumptions.en: Unit square, zero Dirichlet, f=1, diagonal quadrants100/others1, N16/32/64; reference P1 meshes128/192.

algorithm.ja: 直交FVの共有面調和平均。幾何MGと座標を受け取らないSA-AMGの対称Galerkin V-cycleを、同じ行列のPCGへ適用。
algorithm.en: Orthogonal FV with shared harmonic transmissibility. Symmetric Galerkin geometric and coordinate-free SA cycles precondition PCG on identical matrices.

validation.ja: 非零2材料流束パッチ、残差に整合する収支、直接解の前進/energy誤差、独立三角形P1参照の格子感度。
validation.en: Nonzero two-material flux patch, residual-aware budget, direct forward/energy errors and independent triangular-P1 grid sensitivity.

limits.ja: 係数比100の固定例。P1格子差は厳密誤差上界ではなく、特異交点の次数や普遍的なMG/AMG優劣は主張しません。
limits.en: Fixed contrast100 example. P1 differences are not rigorous error bounds; no singular exponent or universal MG/AMG winner is asserted.

title.ja: 回転異方性拡散：完全テンソルQ1とMG・AMG
title.en: Rotated diffusion: full-tensor Q1, MG and AMG

summary.ja: 非零Kxyを保つQ1弱形式で、解析解への収束と同じ行列のMG・AMG収束を比較します。
summary.en: Retain nonzero Kxy in the Q1 weak form and compare analytic refinement with MG/AMG convergence for the same matrix.

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形、零Dirichlet、K=R(pi/6)diag(1,.01)Rᵀ、厳密解sin(pi x)sin(pi y)、N16/32/64。
assumptions.en: Unit square, zero Dirichlet, K=R(pi/6)diag(1,.01)R^T, exact sin(pi x)sin(pi y), N16/32/64.

algorithm.ja: 完全2×2テンソルQ1とGauss積分。MG/SA-AMGは対称2/2Jacobi、Galerkin粗行列、粗CholeskyでSPDの固定適用。
algorithm.en: Full2x2 tensor Q1 and Gauss quadrature. Fixed SPD MG/SA cycles use symmetric2/2Jacobi, Galerkin operators and coarse Cholesky.

validation.ja: u=xy,f=−2Kxyパッチ、解析流束由来のsource、積分L2/energy誤差と4/6点求積感度、直接解との比較。
validation.en: u=xy,f=-2Kxy patch, analytic-flux source, integrated L2/energy error,4/6point quadrature sensitivity and direct-solve comparison.

limits.ja: 指定した角度・異方性の限定例。スカラーTPFAを回転テンソルへ転用せず、一般テンソルへの頑健性は保証しません。
limits.en: One angle/anisotropy only. Scalar TPFA is not extended to rotated tensors; arbitrary-tensor robustness is not established.
